description: This file defines the FormHelper class providing static methods to manipulate Drupal form render arrays, particularly focusing on rewriting #states selectors and adding JavaScript-driven state behaviors.

classes.name: FormHelper
classes.description: A helper class with static methods for manipulating Drupal form render arrays, especially for handling #states and JavaScript behaviors.

methods.name: rewriteStatesSelector
methods.description: Recursively rewrites #states selectors in a render element and its children.

methods.name: processStatesArray
methods.description: Recursively processes and rewrites keys in #states conditions array.

methods.name: processStates
methods.description: Attaches JavaScript libraries and encodes #states into the form element for client-side behavior.
